title: AMC 10 Practice: Coin Flip Probability — 5 Coins vs 7
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on coin flip probability, comparing heads from 5 coins and 7 coins with a flip-symmetry trick and a tiebreak game. (Level 4 of 5)
Ann flips 5 coins and Bob flips 7. What is the chance Bob gets more heads? Vantee shows a neat trick: flip Ann's coins over, and the race turns into one count of 12 coins. Then a second way with a fair game and a tiebreak coin, the traps hiding in the answer choices, and a 3-vs-5 challenge for you to try.
